text: Based on the evidence, the property appears to be legally compliant regarding forests. No tree-cover loss events of 0.5 hectares or more were detected within the asset between 2021 and 2025. The observations indicate that there was no forest cover in 2020, and the only detected tree-cover loss events occurred before the 2020 baseline. Therefore, the property does not have any recent tree-cover loss that would raise compliance concerns.
